points.description: Names a convolutional layer (convolution layer) and says that kernels/filters convolve/slide over the input image (or extract features from it). Equivalent wording counts.
points.partial_credit: Half credit if the answer only names a convolutional layer without saying kernels/filters convolve over the input.

levels.says: Mentions a convolutional layer but does not say kernels/filters convolve over the input image.

points.description: Mentions the other typical CNN layers, including at least two of: activation layer (e.g. ReLU), pooling layer (max or average pooling), fully connected/dense layer(s), and softmax/output layer.
points.partial_credit: Half credit if the answer names only one of these additional layer types.

levels.says: Names only one additional layer type such as pooling, activation/ReLU, fully connected, or softmax.

rubric.notes: Full marks require a convolutional layer with kernels/filters convolving over the input plus at least two other typical CNN layer types. Part marks are given for naming the convolutional layer without its action, or for naming only one additional layer type. No marks are given for answers that do not name correct CNN layer types.
